title: Employee Who Bugged OpenAI Had Saudi Royal Ties, U.S. Prosecutors Say
text:
Prosecutors allege that the OpenAI employee accused of bugging OpenAI’s office had ties to the Saudi Arabian royal family, according to a Sunday filing from the U.S. Attorney’s office in San Francisco.
